_comment: Research tree paid with Éclats, after the Stasis wiki (progression/ascension): three branches, 21 researches. Managers/Stasis/Ascension.cs reads this. A character's ranks survive the Ascension and the Evolution. costs[i] is the price of rank i+1, so maxRank is the length of costs. The value at a rank is values[rank-1] when values is given, else rank x perRank; ranks are cumulative (rank 2 of Endurance is +8 %, not +4 % +8 %). Ordinary ranks are refunded in full, free, out of a fight (.recherche rembourser <id>); permanent ones (Métamorphose, Polyvalence, Évolution) are not. effect is the text of one rank's value, {v} standing for it. kind and where it acts: catchUp (+v to the catch-up experience multiplier, base ascension.json catchUpBase, Dons.ExperienceFactor), catchUpLevels (+v levels above the best level where the catch-up still runs), speed (+v % walk speed out of fight, /api/stasis/speed), animation (+v % fight animation speed, sent to the client), missionXp (+v % to the Système's missions experience), freeRerolls (+v free rerolls each cycle), rarity (dons.json rarity.rareByRank / legendaireByRank at the rank), cards (+v card in every offer but the class passives), repicks (+v free characteristic re-pick each cycle), metamorphose / configs / duoCards (recorded; see Ascension.cs for what is wired), biElement (the second element gets v % of the main element's dons), donPercent (+v % to every characteristic the dons give), lifePercent (+v % max life in fight), resistance (+v % to the five elemental resistances), stat (+v of the named characteristic), castsPerTurn / castsPerTarget (+v cast on the spells capped per turn / per target), evolution (the Évolution itself, done from the Ascension tab).
